name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. The newest open PR is the most likely to have routing errors because it hasn’t been reviewed yet. Shadow mode lets us catch those errors without interfering with the actual review process. The trade-off is delayed feedback for the PR author, but that’s outweighed by preventing bad merges.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks slowing reviews by adding noise to every PR, not just the newest. The real risk is reviewer fatigue from irrelevant PR-Agent comments, which could delay actual fixes. A better alternative is running PR-Agent only on PRs with routing-related keywords in the title or description, which would target likely errors without polluting unrelated reviews. Settle this by measuring reviewer response time before and after a targeted trial.
